selections.comment: MAMMY might be the answer. Now in the care of Rachel Cook and John Bridger, she'd been in winning form on her penultimate start for Michael Bell in January. The daughter of Bated Breath has had only the four runs on turf too, so there could be more improvement in the locker. Golden Pharaoh has become too well handicapped to ignore and enters calculations along with Shaw Park, who hit the woodwork over the mile here recently.

selections.comment: TAWASOL finished a creditable second at Wolverhampton in December before occupying that same position on his reappearance at Catterick earlier this month. Mahra's Love shaped with promise on her racecourse bow in October and she is considered for her powerful yard, while South Shore Island is noted too.

selections.comment: CALAFRIO was caught close home when second at Thirsk on her return to action. The unexposed Jane Temple should not be underestimated now upped in grade, while Karmology is another to consider.

Zooks continues to churn out solid performances at this level and is unlikely to be far away once again, while connections will be hopeful that first-time blinkers can work the oracle for Emaculate Soldier.

Diddy Man and Diamondsinthesand are a couple of others to consider.

selections.comment: Course form may be the way to go here and though POETIC FORCE has shown his best recent form on the AW, all of his best turf efforts have come here. He gets to race off a lower mark on this surface and can take advantage. Marsh Benham has been struggling of late but he's now just 1lb higher than the last of his course victories in the summer so isn't dismissed, while Shaw Park has shown a consistent level of form on varying surfaces recently so is also respected.

However, he might just need this back from a lay off on stable debut and could be vulnerable to the unexposed MAHRA'S LOVE. She can account for Tawasol who has finished runner up on her last couple of outings and the first of those is working out well.

She could go well although she did have a run behind her for those previous victories. It's hard to get away from IT'S TIM who was an impressive winner last time relishing the quick surface. Ten Ten Twenty was successful on the flat and over hurdles last year so isn't dismissed if fit after a lay off.

The consistent and experienced Zayina has met trouble on 2 of her last 3 runs but will be on the premises with a clear passage. Dual AW winner Santorini Star is open to further progress for top connections and completes the list of dangers on her turf debut.

selections.comment: BINT AL DAAR is the clear form pick here. A fast ground winner last summer she was given an awful ride on the AW last time on reappearance and gets to race off the same mark here. Her jockey is a big concern but if building on that effort she will be tough to beat. Yokkell was successful in both codes last year in Ireland and starts out for this new stable of a fair mark. She will need a stiff test at the trip but will be staying on at the finish. She can chase the selection home along with Noisy Jazz who was too keen on her reappearance but is well treated on her previous novice form.

The lack of early pace in the race isn't ideal for her but if getting a stiff test can stay on into a place. Karmology placed twice at this level last year and could do so again if fit for her return.

The latter however, is off quite a layoff and jockey bookings suggest second string to debutant Solarium. She will surely improve and will set a good standard.
